slot.brief: Simplify an expression of the form 1/(a + bi) or a fraction of complex numbers by multiplying with conjugate; express result in standard form.

verdicts.working: Multiply numerator and denominator by the conjugate: \(\frac{1}{3-2i}=\frac{3+2i}{3^2+2^2}=\frac{3+2i}{13}\).

working:
$\dfrac{1}{3-2i}=\dfrac{3+2i}{(3-2i)(3+2i)}$
$=\dfrac{3+2i}{9+4}=\dfrac{3}{13}+\dfrac{2}{13}i$

Independent check: Multiply numerator and denominator by the conjugate: \(\frac{1}{3-2i}=\frac{3+2i}{3^2+2^2}=\frac{3+2i}{13}\).
solution:
Multiply numerator and denominator by the conjugate of $3-2i$:
$$\frac{1}{3-2i}=\frac{3+2i}{(3-2i)(3+2i)}=\frac{3+2i}{3^2+2^2}=\frac{3+2i}{13}.$$
